content.value: Consider an enclosure consisting of two parallel infinite opaque plates. Surfaces 1 and 2 are gray, and are kept at uniform temperatures ${ \mathrm { \ddot { T } } } _ { \mathrm { I } }$ and $\mathrm { T } _ { 2 } ,$ with emissivities $\varepsilon _ { \mathrm { l } }$ and $\mathfrak { E } _ { 2 } ,$ reflectivity $\rho _ { \mathrm { I } }$ and $\rho _ { 2 } ,$ respectively. Develop an expression for radiation exchange between the surfaces.
